First check equivalent work and claim actual ownership. Read products/services/software-renewals/contracts-finder/calendar-en-fr.md, evidence.json, the three relevant releases in the saved raw response, current software-award site files and expiry-transition artifacts. Prepare one concise EN/FR calendar supplement and one contextual homepage link, retaining the existing offer, intake identifier, disclosures and limitations. Independently verify each displayed buyer, supplier, scope, value, date and extension statement against the saved official releases. Explain UK Shared Business Services versus DESNZ, distinguish structured procurement route from description text, and never call an end date a confirmed renewal or bidding opportunity. Translate material French limitations fully. Include official source citation, observation date, OGL attribution and bounded sample coverage; omit personal data. Isolate changes from pending expiry-removal candidates and rejected additions; if safe isolation is unavailable, save the supplement and precise integration handoff outside site files instead. No broader discovery, new software, pricing, outreach, accounts, spending or deployment. Save and read scoped diff, hashes and executed consistency checks. Obtain a dry_run exact digest only for a clean candidate, then request independent AUDITOR review; retain host-enforced writer/reviewer/publisher independence. Complete preparation with an actual valid lease, evidence and a lesson. This improves access to a useful sample, not evidence of acquisition, demand or revenue. Preserve every existing observation deadline and retirement duty.
